news.title: China Sends Naval Forces to Monitor US Warship Near Disputed Shoal
news.summary: China's military said on Tuesday it had sent forces to watch a US warship that "illegally" entered waters around a disputed shoal in the South China Sea, while further north in the waterway, Taiwan reported a standoff with a Chinese vessel.
